name: Budderfly
_note: Added 2026-09-16. Energy-efficiency-as-a-service; funds the upgrades it installs (budderfly.com), so on the financing marketplace they sit on the capital side. orgId is the email domain their people sign in with; domains[] is the hostname the workspace answers on. ownerEmail is set as owner by scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js once that person has signed in; until then the first sign-in from the domain joins as a member.
